entries.en: Ehh, I'm assuming you're here for me?
entries.ro: Eh, presupun că ești aici pentru mine?
Te rog, ai grijă de tine!

entries.en: A little more careful next time!
Yeah... Uh-huh, I can. Yeah, she left a few minutes ago... Nuh-uh, no, she won't get away this time... Mhm, precisely.
entries.ro: Da... Aha, pot. Da, a plecat acum câteva minute... Nu-nu, nu, nu scapă de data asta... Mhm, exact.

entries.en: Don't worry. There's always a way. Always.
entries.ro: Nu-ți face griji. Există întotdeauna o cale. Întotdeauna.

entries.en: Please spare me...! I swear, you won't regret it!
entries.ro: Te rog, cruță-mă...! Jur, n-o să regreți!

entries.en: Is there, uh... some kind of problem?
Please, I am a very busy man, OK?
entries.ro: Te rog, sunt un om foarte ocupat, OK?
